note: Headless, vsync disabled, Apple M3 via ANGLE Metal. Re-recorded because PerfMonitor's window went from 240 to 900 frames (src/core/perf.ts); the previous numbers are not comparable against it. At ~500 fps a 240-frame window is half a second of wall clock, so a single chunk build landing inside it doubled the p95 - which is why the old baseline had to be taken as the slowest of five runs to stop the gate flapping. It shows: the old desktop p95 was 21.8 ms, and the same scene now measures 4.4-6.5 ms with the wider window. The harness delivers 670-920 frames per 6 s measurement, so the window is nearly full and sample() covers essentially the whole run. Second thing that mattered: take these with nothing else on the GPU. Measured with a browser tab rendering the same scene at 60 fps alongside, forest.mobile swung between 1.8 and 8.7 ms; idle, it sits in a 4.1-8.1 band. Observed over four clean runs: desktop median 1.5-1.7 (p95 4.4-6.5), mobile median 4.1-8.1 (p95 14.3-18.1). Recorded here with about 10% over the slowest of each. Both are far inside the 16.7/33.3 ms hard budgets; the number that describes what a player gets is the interactive one with vsync on, 16.7-17.8 ms median at 4.1M triangles and 110 draw calls.
